description: PDF tools verified and approved during Wave 1. Most tested via tsx importing real production functions. pdf-to-image and pdf-to-text verified via Playwright e2e in real Chromium browser.
testHarness: scratch/wave1-real-test.ts (tsx v4.23.12, imports real exports from pdf-tools.ts)

tools.name: PDF Merger
tools.engine: pdf-lib mergePDFs() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: PDF Splitter
tools.engine: pdf-lib splitPDF() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: PDF Delete Pages
tools.engine: pdf-lib removePages() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: Rearrange Pages
tools.engine: pdf-lib organizePages() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: PDF Rotate Pages
tools.engine: pdf-lib rotatePDF() — real export, imported via tsx
tools.actual: rotation=90° verified on first page, 1445 bytes
tools.verificationMethod: Direct function import + PDFDocument.load + getRotation().angle check

tools.name: PDF Page Cropper
tools.engine: pdf-lib cropPDF() — real export, imported via tsx
tools.verificationMethod: Direct function import + PDFDocument.load + getCropBox() check

tools.name: PDF to Image
tools.expected: ZIP of 3 JPG images (one per page)
tools.actual: ZIP: page-1.jpg (59806 bytes), page-2.jpg, page-3.jpg — valid JPEG magic bytes confirmed, 3 files for 3 pages
tools.verificationMethod: Playwright e2e: real Chromium browser, file upload via UI, download ZIP, inspect contents + JPEG magic bytes

tools.name: Image to PDF
tools.engine: pdf-lib imagesToPDF() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: Add Watermark
tools.engine: pdf-lib addWatermark() — real export, imported via tsx

tools.name: Add Headers/Footers
tools.engine: pdf-lib addHeaderFooter() — real export, imported via tsx
tools.expected: Header and footer text on all pages

tools.name: View/Edit Metadata
tools.actual: title='Real Test Title', author='Real Author' verified via getTitle()/getAuthor()

tools.name: PDF to Text
tools.expected: Extracted text with all content from 3 pages in reading order
tools.actual: 659 bytes of extracted text. Contains: 'Chapter 1: The Beginning', 'Chapter 2: The Journey', 'Chapter 3: The Arrival' — all in correct reading order with page markers.
tools.verificationMethod: Playwright e2e: real Chromium browser, file upload via UI, download text file, assert all chapters present in order

tools.name: Fill PDF Forms
tools.engine: pdf-lib form API via processFiles dispatcher
tools.testInput: PDF with name_field, email_field, agree_check; fill with test values
tools.verificationMethod: processFiles('fill-forms', [file], { formData }) + PDFDocument.load + form field getters

tools.name: Flatten Forms
tools.testInput: PDF with 3 filled form fields, then flatten
tools.expected: Fields removed (0 interactive fields), content preserved
tools.actual: Fields went from 3→0 after flatten. form.flatten() confirmed working.

unfixedBugs.bug: Falls through to add-date-stamp — user gets a date stamp instead of image embedding
Falls through to flatten-forms — user gets form flattening instead of comment addition
